notes.title: Update 1.01
notes.notes:
HI! Thanks everyone who got the game early on! Here's an update with mostly bugfixes for stuff we found in the first week since release. If you like the game we would be superhappy if you could spread the word and write a review! 


Fixed in this version:
- Error message popping up when entering "player levels" on OSX. Thanks @TheRagingRhino for finding this one!

- Fixed background for wide displays (like 21:9 )

- Fixed button position on reward screens

- Minor layout fixes


Thanks!!


[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27527136/40012d827884b593af3aaa15653eebb9f93fa58c.png[/img]
"SUNSHINE IN THE MOUNTAINS" by CoreGamesTV

notes.title: Release version!
notes.notes:
We've uploaded v 1.0 and everything is set for release tomorrow!

[FIXED] We fixed a bug where you could enter exit the pause menu repeatedly to get supersonic speeds! While it was pretty cool to charge up the Hanger this way, it didn't work well with the leaderboards :) Thanks to Sabre for reporting this and helping us fix it.

- We also decided to keep all leveleditor objecs unlocked (normally you would unlock them by collecting coins in player levels). This is to make it easier to create some cool levels in the beginning. We'll keep it like that for at least 2 weeks! 

Have fun swinging!

notes.title: January 15 update
notes.notes:
We fixed a couple of bugs and some smaller stuff. Less than 10 days to release now!

[+] Added support for start button to pause / unpause
[FIXED] Could get minus time counting if pausing before the level starts
[FIXED] Pausing and unpausing too quick can lead to time getting messed up
[FIXED] Goal position to low in the editor
[FIXED] Text alignments

That's it for now! 
As a bonus, here's a test i made with lots of lasers:
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/3ohc11zxJOTlaCBSPm/giphy.gif[/img]

notes.title: All Editor objects unlocked in latest update
notes.notes:
Hi! 
We just uploaded an update that unlocks all objects in the leveleditor from start. We will keep it this way during final testing until the release.
(In the release version you unlock the leveleditor objects by playing other player levels ) 

Richard also made a couple of quick but cool player levels, so its not as empty in the player level section. If you make a level in the editor make sure you press publish so that we can feature it for all testers to see.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27527136/531ba08bb1de48d495c1641f4949d34dc83e81da.jpg[/img]

Thanks!

/ Christian

notes.title: Update will erase all save files (but not anymore!)
notes.notes:
Hello fellow swingers!

We have uploaded a new update today and just so you know it will erase your save files! So it's back to level one, sorry about that :)

However, as we get closer to the release version, every update after this one should not erase your save files!

If you desperately need to retrieve your old save files there is a way though, contact us and we'll help you out.

Thank you for playing Hanger World!

notes.title: Release date - 24 jan!
notes.notes:
TADA - After lot's of polishing and playing we're pretty much ready for the release. And we have a date! So add it to your wishlist and tell your friends about the game! We also made a new trailer, new screenshots and some gifs for the steam page. All in all we're really happy with how the game is turning out and it's definitely the best Hanger we've done so far.

notes.title: New beta version!
notes.notes:
News news! 
The game is now pretty much feature complete for the release. 

We've added in all the levels, the editor and you can play featured player levels. 
You can also share levelCodes and play other players levels! We're still working on that feature, so might be a bit bumpy until we've figured it out. But feel free to share your level codes! The levels that we feature in the player levels section automatically gets leaderboards, so it's possible to compete with times on them.

We've also added in some new rewards to unlock, including a silhouette mode that looks pretty cool! 

Here's some screens:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27527136/64239567dc20f53962b9321c03007ea13b3f1645.png[/img][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27527136/2bad3360c025358dfc1ce2b30b9aebcdaa59c4bd.png[/img][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27527136/aff6dd4e19db925e7eabe8225d0088fa8d23bb60.png[/img][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27527136/38d38345363d3b32f5233927fb9b275a7b3a4ca4.png[/img][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27527136/e40ea6fc23060b9ccfebd8be29f9cc3ce9ba43ea.png[/img]
